programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.sub_title: Juan Carlos Visits the Neighbourhood; Daniel Shows Juan Carlos the Clock
programs.desc: Daniel can't wait to show Juan Carlos the Clock Factory, but remembers to ask Juan Carlos what he wants to do first. Daniel is a good host and they make a stop at the Music Shop for Juan Carlos and his mom.

programs.title: The Makery
programs.desc: Before the excitement of the fair, Nim creates a sponge alien picture, bakes a fajita crab and makes a hook-a-duck game with the help of one of the Crafty Kids.

programs.title: Play School: Rainforest Rangers
programs.desc: Rangers Miah and Alex explore the layers of the rainforest, from the forest floor to the emergent layer at the top! They play a guessing game using items from each layer, and Alex hangs around like a flying fox!

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Evie and Tsehay are in the Wiggly Kitchen playing, 'name that kitchen sound'. They come across some hay and they don't know what to do with it, the Dancing Water Police of Wiggle Town will know what to do.

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Fizzy and Suds follow a garbage truck, watching bins lifted and rubbish shaken, and see how recycling turns trash into something completely new.

programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: While playing pretend pirate ship in the playground with her friends, Miffy goes a bit 'overboard' and is unwilling to let her playmates take a turn at being the captain.

programs.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programs.desc: Gingers tells the Pea-Rexes that she has a delicious treat for them - a hearty breakfast of yummy drops  except there is a twist. Ginger has hidden the drops and they have to go on a treasure hunt to find them!

programs.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programs.desc: When the museum's prized prehistoric tumbleweed goes missing, Andy heads back 85 million years in time to try & find more. On his search he helps a mother dinosaur protect her nest & then manages to get covered in dino snot!

programs.title: Santiago of the Seas
programs.sub_title: The Curse of the Gold Falcon
programs.desc: Santiago and crew set sail to return the Golden Falcon idol back to its rightful resting place.

programs.title: Mojo Swoptops
programs.desc: Pirate bus Ted is hijacked by Captain Dot, and Mojo and Bo sail the streets to stop her.

programs.title: Bluey
programs.desc: Bluey's Father's Day card has to be perfect but she can't decide what to draw! So Mum reminds her about all the fun times she's had with Dad and how he's not so perfect either.
